info.name: Bounding box labeling with GPT-6 Astra
info.description: Zero-shot object detector that labels objects with bounding boxes using GPT-6 Astra. To detect more complex objects you can combine this block with other labeling blocks.

parameters.name: OpenAI API Key
parameters.help: An OpenAI API key with access to GPT-6 Astra.

parameters.name: Prompt
parameters.help: Objects to label, one per line. Put the label in parentheses, e.g. 'A person (person)'. Without parentheses the line is used as the label.
parameters.placeholder: Objects to label, one per line. Put the label in parentheses.
parameters.hint: Separate multiple objects with a newline. You can specify the label in the parenthesis (e.g. 'A person (person)').

parameters.name: Reasoning effort
parameters.help: GPT-6 Astra reasoning effort. Higher effort can improve box placement but costs more and takes longer.

valid.label: Only if it matches the label

parameters.name: Ignore objects smaller than (%)
parameters.help: Any objects where the area is smaller than X% of the whole image will be ignored

parameters.name: Ignore objects larger than (%)
parameters.help: Any objects where the area is larger than X% of the whole image will be ignored
